title: S01-03 - The Creature and Her Young

sections.title: Player text
sections.body: From behind the cart steps a large creature: the body of a wolf, the face of an owl, broad feathered wings folded along its back. It lifts its head from the meal and studies you, unhurried, deciding whether you are a threat. Then, behind it, two smaller shapes stumble into view: clumsy, big-eyed, and keeping close to its legs.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Deal with the creature without anyone, including the pups, getting hurt, and clear the road.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Reveal the feeding creature by description first, then show that she is protecting pups and is not the simple monster story.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Player-safe: wary mother animal, two pups, road blocked by a decision.
GM-only: she did not kill the driver; she is not manufactured.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "She has not attacked. She is watching you and keeping herself between you and the young. If you want the name, locals call this kind of creature a strixwolf. The important part right now is not the name. It is her posture. What signal do you give her?"
